 'B: eps^a T^b exp(k eps) + eps^p T^q': lambda P: [base, eps**P[0]*T**P[1]*np.exp(P[2]*eps), eps**P[3]*T**P[4]],

 'D: eps^a T^b + eps^p exp(k/T)*T^q': lambda P: [base, eps**P[0]*T**P[1], eps**P[2]*T**P[3]*np.exp(P[4]/T)],
 'E: eps^a exp(k/T) + eps^p log(T)': lambda P: [base, eps**P[0]*np.exp(P[1]/T), np.log(T)*eps**P[2]],
}

 'P: eps^a T^b + eps^p exp(k/T)': (lambda P: [base, eps**P[0]*T**P[1], eps**P[2]*np.exp(P[3]/T)], 4),
}
